name: lqt-lesson-designer-mcp
description: Integrated LQT active learning lesson design with target-choice branching, evidence-rich tasks and 4-3-2-1 criteria.

capabilities: Generate daily learning targets from an entered standard
Design complete LQT active learning lessons
interface.longDescription: Design complete ready-to-teach lessons in the LQT Active Learning Lesson Framework. Ask grade and whether a target already exists; otherwise derive and offer daily learning targets from the exact standard for educator selection. Then ask class period length. Integrates original LQT opening and closing strategies, G.I.S.T. mini-lessons, authentic engaging tasks, targeted scaffolds and the 4-3-2-1 Progressive Success Criteria format. Adapts learner-facing language to unrestricted grade levels.

positive.prompt: Grade 5. Yes, I have a target: I can explain energy transfer in a food web. Class is 45 minutes. Design my lesson.
positive.expected_behavior: Skip standard branch; full lesson with four components totaling 45 minutes and 4-3-2-1 success criteria.

positive.prompt: Grade 7. No target yet. State standard: 7.NR.1.8 Represent multiplication and division of integers using various strategies and interpret products and quotients in relevant situations.
positive.expected_behavior: Numbered daily I can targets, Know, Do, Connection; stop and ask educator to select before duration or lesson.

positive.prompt: Kindergarten. Target: I can compare objects by size. 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use comprehensible age-appropriate learner directions; preserve rigorous observable task and 4-3-2-1 evidence.

positive.prompt: Adult learners. Target: I can evaluate evidence in a written argument. 75 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unrestricted grade entry and produce adult-appropriate GIST, worthy task, aligned criteria and closing.

positive.prompt: Review a Grade 6, 50 minute moon phases lesson with a 15-minute opening, 10-minute work session, no evidence collection, and ascending 1-2-3-4 rubric.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag timing, weak evidence and reversed criteria order; recommend specific improvements.

negative.prompt: Write a recipe for banana bread.
Grade 4, no target. State standard: Write informative texts on a topic and convey ideas clearly.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask educator to choose one of derived targets before asking duration or generating lesson.
Ask grade level first, not a plan or a grade dropdown.

publication.release_notes: Adds recorded demonstration and updated original Lesson Designer icon; retains integrated lesson-design framework, target selection, and progressive success criteria.
